dedup_notes: Deterministic pass (2a): f002 and f026 clustered (same file backend/src/auth/password.ts, same category weak-crypto, lines 3 and 9, within 10) -> canonical f002, absorbed f026. Semantic pass (2b): subagent proposed GROUP: f015 <- f013 (access-token-in-JSON-body vs access-token-in-localStorage). Orchestrator override: NOT merged. Rationale: different files/layers (backend auth.controller.ts vs frontend authApi.ts), independently exploitable (direct localStorage.getItem() needs no network interception, vs f015 requiring fetch/XHR interception), and independently fixable (removing the backend JSON field does not remove the frontend's dangerous localStorage-write pattern, which would reactivate if any other flow ever returns a token in a body). Kept as two distinct candidates so Phase 3 verifies each independently.
